probe.response: exact torch.func.jvp of PI05 velocity with respect to the complete noisy action sequence

claim_boundary: This proves only that an exact paired PI05 action-sequence JVP is computable at practical A40 memory. One task and one expert do not establish held geometry, closed-loop prediction, or a decoder objective.
next_use: Only if the validation8 local-expert ceiling is broad, collect a small fixed successful/on-policy action-JVP-stage panel before deciding whether JVP belongs in the functional manifold.
